sentences.text: The turret ring, wedged solid with compacted chalk, refused the crane's first pull. Careful stratigraphy matters more than speed here — the burn layer above the hull dates the engagement. Honestly, I expected bones; instead we lifted a periscope housing, intact, glass and all. Under the sponson lay forty-three cartridge cases, each one bagged, labeled, and logged before dark. Before the hull travels anywhere, the museum's registrar wants a complete condition report on file. A curator photographed each road wheel in situ, numbering them against the site grid. Deeper down the soil turns anaerobic and blue-grey, which is why any steel survived at all. Fragments of a crewman's map case emerged from the silt beside the driver's position. Corrosion had welded the hatch shut, so the team documented the interior with a borescope. Soil samples from stratum IV still smell faintly of diesel, eighty years on. I spent the morning siphoning debris from between the spiderwood branches so nothing would cloud the final photographs. After the awards, competitors swapped trimming techniques over cold noodles, sketching hardscape ideas on the backs of their scoring sheets. Newcomers learn the hard way that a focal point placed dead center costs points on every judge's sheet. The judges docked her two points because the hairgrass carpet had lifted near the front glass overnight. By noon the convention hall smelled of wet soil and glue, and every competitor was pretending not to study the neighboring entries. Photography day means blackout curtains, a rented strobe, and forty minutes of coaxing the rummynose tetras into the golden-ratio zone. Nobody expected the ninety-centimeter iwagumi to beat last year's champion, yet there it sat, first-place ribbon taped to its cabinet. We hauled buckets down the loading dock at dawn, praying the amano shrimp had survived the drive from Portland. "Your negative space carries the whole composition," the Belgian judge told him, tapping the empty sand foreground. His bucephalandra had melted two weeks before judging; he entered anyway. What is the meaning of the word tank?
